mr_title: Start building against Spring LDAP 4.1.0-M1 snapshots

expected_issues.title: Health is not UP when the LDAP version is unavailable
expected_issues.description:
builder.up() is now only called when the LDAP protocol version can be read, so a reachable LDAP server that does not expose the version is reported with status UNKNOWN instead of UP.

The null-check added for the new nullability contract wraps the whole `builder.up().withDetail(...)` call. The health check succeeded (the read-only operation did not throw), so the status must be UP regardless; only the 'version' detail should be conditional.
